subject: absurd
title: Stale-lease writes (still true).
evidence: - complete_run checks only state='running' (:1108). extend_claim rejects only a NULL expiry (:1602), not an expired one. set_task_checkpoint_state checks neither the lease nor the run state (:1491-1525) (code shows). - Consequence (inferred): a worker whose lease expired, but which has not yet been swept, can extend the lease, write checkpoints and complete the run, even though the lease logically passed to nobody yet. If another worker has already re-claimed, the old run is failed and its writes raise AB002, so the guard holds only after a sweep (prior note §3).

subject: absurd
title: Event names are reused, not consumed (still true).
evidence: - An event row keeps its payload until cleanup_events (:2252-2293). await_event resolves at once from it (:1797-1825) (code shows). - A second task, or a second loop iteration, that waits on the same name gets the old payload without suspending (inferred). The author's mitigation is unique names (README.md:162).

subject: absurd
title: An awaitEvent timeout writes no checkpoint, so replay diverges (open issue #96).
evidence: - TS and Python throw TimeoutError before calling SQL, based on wake_event (index.ts:509-517; __init__.py:806-812). The SQL timeout path also returns without a checkpoint (:1842-1851). Any later suspension clears wake_event (schedule_run :1175, fail_run :1257) (code shows). - On the next replay the timed-out await finds no checkpoint and registers a fresh wait. The task then re-suspends on a stale event for a full timeout. If the event arrives later, the replay takes the payload branch instead of the timeout branch (inferred). - The reporter measured an extra 5 minutes of delay with 300 s time

title: Model requests are re-sent after a crash
evidence: Model requests are re-sent after a crash (spec §8.3; generation.ts:73, 209-236). Spend is repeated and the answer may differ. Nothing marks the re-send. users report combined with OOM this loops (#11139).

subject: pi-durable

subject: pi-durable

evidence: "Interrupted" relies on the model. An unsafe tool is never re-run by the harness, but a model can re-issue it (withone.ai: Haiku 4.5 duplicated a Gmail draft). None of the built-in tools is replay-safe or keyed (C15). The fix exists only as a roadmap issue (#10624).
